subject: integration
name: Explore
summary: A search row that opens Orivon Explore, a static directory of Web3 sites with their Web3 Scores, at explore.orivonstack.eth, with the typed words after the # of the address so they stay on this computer. The page asks no other party for anything and loads no outside code, image or font. It reads a Web3 Score through the browser only when the visitor grants it, from the provider the person chose, judged on its own row, and acts only on a 3 or 4 for a site it observed at 2. Its listings and Orivon-app marks are its publisher's own data, which nothing checks. Judged here by its publisher.
